limits.result_interpretation: Reported directions are extracted from abstracts and detected Results sections within the indexed-text scan. Compatible comparisons require matching stated drugs, species, temperatures, doses, routes, comparators and remaining detected context; papers reaching the finding limit are excluded. Shared-outcome groups span different experiments and are not direct comparisons. Counts are descriptive; minority directions are not statistical outliers and missing extraction is not evidence of no effect.
limits.interpretation: Explicit aims come from abstracts, introductions and unheaded introductory text within the first 60000 indexed characters; explicit retrospective statements of study purpose may also come from Discussion or Conclusion sections. A title-derived focus is labelled separately and is not an invented aim. Relationships are stated links, not proof of causation; papers without a valid pair remain in the atlas.
